description: Use this when the user wants to post to their personal LinkedIn profile. Publishing costs no credits. Publish a post to the user’s connected LinkedIn profile — text, and optionally an image (imageUrl), a VIDEO (videoUrl, with captionsSrt and a videoThumbnailUrl cover), a 2–20 image MULTI-IMAGE post (imageUrls), a LINK post with a real preview card (linkUrl + linkTitle / linkDescription / linkThumbnailUrl — LinkedIn never scrapes the page), a DOCUMENT post (documentUrl: a PDF / PPTX readers swipe through), and @mentions of companies (mentions). The image does NOT have to be something Hermoso generated: LinkedIn is served the bytes from us, so the URL must be Hermoso-hosted, and upload_file turns ANY file the user already has into exactly that. This PUBLISHES immediately and PUBLICLY — ALWAYS show the user the exact text and get an explicit yes BEFORE calling. Needs a connected LinkedIn account (Settings > Connectors > LinkedIn).

allowDuplicate.description: post it even though an identical post was just made or attempted. Only pass this when the user genuinely wants the same thing posted twice, or when you have LOOKED at the account and confirmed a timed-out attempt did not land.

altText.description: image alt text — a string for every image, or an array per slide

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Beats the connection's pin for THIS CALL ONLY; a name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

captionsSrt.description: SRT caption CONTENT for a videoUrl post (English only, attached during upload)

documentTitle.description: the title shown on the document (defaults to the file name)

documentUrl.description: a DOCUMENT post — a Hermoso-hosted PDF / PPTX / DOCX (upload_file first) that readers swipe through page by page in the feed; LinkedIn takes up to 100MB and 300 pages. One kind of media per post: not with an image, video, slides or linkUrl.

hook.description: WHAT ANGLE this post is built on, recorded only at publish time. post_performance ranks hooks on it (a winner needs 5 posts sharing ONE hook), so pass a list_hooks id (e.g. "direct_callout", "before_after") or reuse your own wording EXACTLY across a campaign. Omit it and this post never votes on which hook works.

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

idempotencyKey.description: SAFE RETRIES — any stable string: a repeat of the SAME publish within 24h returns the ORIGINAL post id instead of posting again (an identical publish is also auto-recognised for 10 minutes). On a timeout or an ambiguous error, CALL AGAIN WITH THE SAME KEY: it reports the original post or publishes it once. It never posts twice.

imageUrl.description: a Hermoso-hosted image URL to attach (≤12MB) — a Hermoso render, or ANY file of the user’s own put through upload_file first. An arbitrary external host is refused (we fetch the bytes ourselves).

imageUrls.description: a MULTI-IMAGE post: 2–20 Hermoso-hosted images in order, one post the reader swipes through (LinkedIn’s MultiImage API takes a member author on w_member_social). Images only.

linkDescription.description: link card description; LinkedIn does not read the page, so set it here

linkTitle.description: the card headline — LinkedIn never scrapes the page, so without it the card is unlabelled

linkUrl.description: a LINK post with a real preview card. Not with media.

mentions.description: TAG COMPANIES: write "@Name" in the text where each tag goes and list each company here — its vanity name (the part after linkedin.com/company/), its company page URL, or {organizationId, name}. Hermoso resolves it on LinkedIn and LinkedIn renders a real clickable mention; a company with no "@" spot in the text is refused rather than appended.

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

subject.description: WHAT THIS POST IS ABOUT — product, feature, offer or theme (e.g. "winter coat", "free trial"). post_performance's second grouping axis: reuse the exact wording, as with hook.

videoThumbnailUrl.description: cover image for a videoUrl post (Hermoso-hosted)

videoUrl.description: a Hermoso-hosted video (a render, or the user’s footage via upload_file). LinkedIn processes it before publishing, which takes a minute.

name: post_to_linkedin
title: Publish to LinkedIn
